title: Surrealist Compositions: Dali Meets AI
description: How to make MJ generate gallery-worthy surrealism. Compositional rules, artist anchors, and dream logic.

prompt.main: surrealist composition in the style of salvador dali, melting bronze clock draped over a desert cactus, distant floating elephant with skyscrapers growing from its back, golden hour light, hyperrealistic textures, vast empty desert plain, dreamscape, museum quality fine art photography --v 6.1 --ar 4:5 --s 850

explained.why: Very high stylize. Surrealism needs MJ to take creative risks.

explained.param: in the style of salvador dali
explained.why: Artist anchor 鈥?instantly locks to "museum surrealism" not "random weird".
Quality anchor 鈥?keeps it gallery-grade, not amateur weird.

tutorial.intro: Surrealism is about dream logic + symbolic contrast. MJ does this brilliantly with the right anchors.
steps: Artist anchor: in the style of salvador dali 鈥?instantly locks the dreamlike vibe.
Symbolic contrast: melting bronze clock draped over a desert cactus 鈥?combine unrelated objects with meaning.
Scale play: distant floating elephant with skyscrapers growing from its back 鈥?surrealism loves impossible scale.
Setting: vast empty desert plain 鈥?Dali's signature empty space.
Quality anchor: museum quality fine art photography 鈥?keeps it gallery-grade.
tutorial.tips: Surrealism needs symbolic contrast. Pick two unrelated objects and combine them: "clock + cactus", "elephant + skyscrapers", "fish + umbrella".

crossModel.midjourney: Use the rewrite prompt with --s 850 for max creativity.

faq.q: Why is my surreal image just "weird"?
faq.a: You forgot the artist anchor. "Salvador Dali" / "Magritte" / "Beksinski" instantly adds meaning.
Symbolic contrast works. Random mashup doesn't. Combine 2 objects with implied meaning.
--s 800+. High stylize = more creative risk = better surrealism.
